test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are INCORRECT?

(i) The transport of insoluble product of photosynthesis is known as translocation.

(ii) Respiration is the evaporative loss of water through stomata.

(iii) Photosynthesis is the process by which autotrophs take in substances from outside and in the absence of sunlight convert them into stored forms of energy.
solution:
The correct answer is __**(i), (ii) and (iii)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• (i) The term "translocation" is indeed used for the transport of soluble products of photosynthesis, not insoluble products.
 
• (ii) Respiration is the metabolic process of breaking down glucose to release energy, not the evaporative loss of water through stomata. The process of water loss through stomata is known as transpiration.
 
• (iii) Photosynthesis requires sunlight to convert substances into stored forms of energy (glucose). The given statement incorrectly states that it occurs in the absence of sunlight.
 
• All three statements (i), (ii), and (iii) are factually incorrect based on fundamental biological concepts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Translocation in Plants**

 
 
• Translocation refers to the movement of soluble products of photosynthesis, such as sugars, from the leaves to other parts of the plant.
 
• This process occurs through the phloem tissue.
 
 
 
• **Respiration in Plants**
 
 
• Respiration is a biochemical process where glucose is broken down to release energy, carbon dioxide, and water.
 
• This process occurs in the mitochondria of cells and is vital for energy production in both plants and animals.
 
 
 
• **Transpiration in Plants**
 
 
• Transpiration is the process of water vapor loss from the plant to the atmosphere through stomata.
 
• This helps in nutrient transport, cooling the plant, and maintaining water balance.
 
 
 
• **Photosynthesis**
 
 
• Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight to synthesize nutrients from carbon dioxide and water.
 
• The general equation for photosynthesis is: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light energy → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂.
